title: Provider-neutral operational CLI, configuration, and onboarding
invariants: Every command is bound to AR-0024 revision 3, one project, worktree, session, and supplied invocation.
Configuration and command arguments contain bounded identifiers, enumerations, finite limits, and SHA-256 digests only; no command executes a provider, process, network, or shell operation.
Setup precedes run; observe precedes interruption; resume requires the exact acknowledged checkpoint; diagnosis and shutdown are observations, not authority decisions.
Safe shutdown is acknowledged only after diagnosis and always reports durable_state not_performed and remote_verification unverified.
One command event ID and one evidence digest are used at most once; malformed, stale, crossed, replayed, or unauthorized transitions fail closed.

failure_semantics.side_effects: No provider, LLM, network, process, shell, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, or durable-state operation is performed.

privacy.allowed_values: bounded identifiers, offline profile, enumerations, finite non-negative limits, booleans, and SHA-256 digests

limitations: A passing trace proves only deterministic command contract and supplied observation shape.
It does not install, launch, inspect, resume, or stop a real runtime and does not prove filesystem isolation, lease validity, provider behavior, or remote consumption.
Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI remain authoritative; runtime statuses cannot manufacture their decisions or durable state.
A future live implementation must introduce a separately versioned revision-bound execution contract and host enforcement evidence.
follow_up: AR-0027 may consume this interface for operational integration after independent qualification.
